Fees, settlement & trust

Clear answers before
you raise your hand.

  • How money moves Accept → see payment → manage wallet → withdraw through supported partners where available.
  • Fees & settlement Vary by market and partners. We’ll confirm what applies to your location before you onboard.
  • Wallet control You control access to your merchant wallet and can see balances as payments land.
  • Built for the counter Merchants experience payments and balances—not infrastructure jargon at checkout.

What’s next: in-network business payments are live. Global accounts & cards are planned—not generally available.

Common questions

Straight answers
before you start.

We’ll confirm onboarding requirements and supported payment options for your market.

How can my business accept a Kura payment?+

Eligible merchants use the Kura merchant experience to accept supported QR- or code-based transactions.

Does my business need POS hardware?+

Supported merchant payment workflows are mobile-first and do not require a dedicated card terminal.

Who controls the merchant wallet?+

You control access to your merchant wallet. See balances as payments land, and use supported withdrawal options for your market.

What about fees and cash-out?+

Fees, settlement timing, and withdrawal options vary by market and partner. Contact Kura to discuss your location before onboarding.

Which countries are supported?+

Availability varies by market and eligibility. Tell us your country and we’ll confirm what is open for merchants today.
